title: Milestone
description: A dated point of progress in a project. Linked to its project with schema:about (schema:superEvent accepts only an Event). Status and dates follow the Open Contracting Data Standard milestone: dueDate is when it is scheduled, dateMet is when it was reached.

status.description: termCode from the `MilestoneStatus` code list (OCDS). Not the project status vocabulary.

dueDate.description: When the milestone is scheduled to be reached.

dateMet.description: When the milestone was actually reached.
